notes.demo_account: No accounts exist. The reviewer path is a local model download or an owner-provided spend-capped key (docs/store/review-notes.md section 3). It works only once local models are wired into the shell (audit S-07, S-08).
notes.live_backend: There is no Demios backend. Network services are the user's own provider, Hugging Face and MCP servers the user adds.
notes.review_notes: Draft in docs/store/review-notes.md. Placeholders and features not yet in the shell must be resolved before submission.
notes.screenshots_match_build: Existing screenshots in apps/desktop/docs/screenshots are dev captures with the fake model. Recapture from the release build (audit S-24).
notes.account_deletion_device_test: No accounts. Local data deletion is tracked separately (audit S-27).
notes.privacy_labels_match_runtime: Declaration drafted in docs/store/readiness-audit.md (no data collected by the developer). Still to do: verify against the release build's network traffic, including the update check once it exists.
notes.iap_reachable_by_reviewer: Free app with no in-app purchases (D-018).
